adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new logic iterates destinations with a `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` loop and, when a credential isn’t found in `this.calendarCredentials`, performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique(...)` inside the loop. It also `await`s `createEvent(...)` inside that same loop, making calendar API calls sequential per destination. This creates diff-grounded N+1 DB lookups and serialized external calls, so booking latency can scale roughly linearly with destination/host count. This is a performance/architecture concern rather than a functional defect.
